I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use config.publicUrl instead of process.env.PUBLIC_URL (falling back to http://localhost:3000) so password reset emails point to the configured public URL rather than localhost.
args.title: Use config.publicUrl for password reset email links
